name: ratchet
summary: Use when a loop must keep a change only if a guarded metric strictly improves
intents: keep change only if metric improves
measure candidate then keep or revert
hill climb a metric with git
discard change that does not improve
experiment log with keep and discard

exit_codes.0: try: keep, or with --dry-run the plan for an in-scope candidate; init: baseline recorded; status, finish: printed
exit_codes.1: try: discard, guard-fail or scope-fail (with --dry-run: would scope-fail); init: guard failed at the baseline; finish: nothing kept
exit_codes.2: usage error, including try without a candidate change
exit_codes.3: crash (metric failed, timed out or printed no number) or environment error (git missing, not a work tree, dirty at init, wrong branch, branch moved)
exit_codes.4: try: trial budget exhausted; nothing is run or changed
